title: Four-loop Anomalous Dimensions of Scalar-QED Theory from Operator Product Expansion
summary: We apply the Operator Product Expansion (OPE) algorithm to the renormalization of scalar-QED theory, with a specific focus on the fixed-charge operator $φ^Q$. Within the OPE framework, the anomalous dimension of the $φ^Q$ operator is perturbatively computed to four-loop order in the modified minimal subtraction scheme, extending beyond the previously available three-loop result. The beta functions, as well as the mass and field anomalous dimensions, are also computed at this order.
